operational_policy.upload_preflight: Fail closed on invalid signature, >25 MiB, encryption, active/embedded content, and missing EOF; persist SHA-256 and source_group_id.
operational_policy.digital_text: May proceed to canonical extraction but SOURCE_READY is allowed only if the existing source-trust gate passes and table-role ambiguity is absent.
operational_policy.scan_or_empty_text: OCR_REQUIRED; text-only OCR cannot become trusted table evidence without structure/provenance validation.
operational_policy.ambiguous_structure: REVIEW_REQUIRED; never promote by fallback success alone.
